description:
Shatter Special #1 (1985), First Comics Deluxe Series - "The First Computerized Comic!" Art drawn on an Apple Macintosh by Mike Saenz, story by Peter B. Gillis. Baxter paper, $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: American Flagg! Hard Times graphic novel ad by Howard Chaykin.

Condition: front cover bright, with a small chip at the lower right edge. The back cover has paper loss and chipping along the left edge (see close-up).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
